755010102.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Huh, didn't expect to see you here!

755010103.text: Wait, are you here on some sort of super-awesome commission? Is it about the Spiritway over there?

755010106.text: Speaking of which, the person who commissioned us is also from the Children of Echoes. Maybe you know each other...

755010107.text: You describe your encounter with "Dopey Dazzler," her views on graffiti, and her invitation for you to study avant-garde thought...

755010108.text: Oh, so that's who you met? I know her.

755010109.text: She doesn't look like a big deal, quite like me, in fact. But if you get her talking, she can go on forever... If you hang out with her a bit more, you might see a... different side to Natlan, I guess?

755010110.text: Did you become friends after she invited you to draw graffiti with her as well?

755010111.text: Well, not really? We met by chance...

755010112.text: That was a long time ago. I was buying fruit at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame with my parents, and there she was, sitting at the paint shop entrance, watching as Acat blended paints.

755010113.text: She would sit there for half a day, almost, not moving a muscle, as though she could see something special in all those different colors.

755010114.text: She was so focused at that moment. It was like she couldn't care less about anything except the paints! And so I thought she wouldn't notice me—

755010115.text: Only for her to notice the color of my clothes as I passed, then start chatting with me about our favorite colors. It was like she'd become a different person!

755010116.text: Well, your clothes are pretty unique! Seems like the Dopey Dazzler's got a good eye for this kind of thing.
